statistics.zero_event_bound: corruption_upper95_onesided = 1 - 0.05^(1/n) (Clopper-Pearson upper limit), reported when 0 events
statistics.independence: trials run sequentially against the same worker; worker state and allocator history can correlate them, so treat the intervals as approximate, not as a sampling of independent identical runs

differential_basis: difference in OBSERVED outcomes under this trigger; it is not by itself evidence that the patch caused the difference. Source analysis is separate and labelled in PATCH_MAP.md.

attribution.causal_request: not established (corruption detected in a later request)

scope: Corruption is a denial-of-service observation. No memory disclosure or code execution is attempted or claimed.
